books_config.name: Prudent
books_config.description: A quarter of Kelly on the Brent fund, never levered and never short. It is the book one could keep in an account without margin: it buys BNO when the forecast is long and stays in cash otherwise.

books_config.name: Dynamic
books_config.description: Half Kelly on the Brent fund, long and short. Long: BNO up to 2x on margin (the most Regulation T allows overnight). Short: it buys SCO, the fund that returns -2 times WTI each day, with cash and never beyond 100% of the account. The same forecast as the prudent book, twice the risk, and the short side too.

books_config.name: Aggressive
books_config.description: Full Kelly on the micro WTI future, long and short, up to 10x. The leverage is not chosen: it comes out of the ratio between the volatility target and the volatility of the moment. With crude at 50% volatility it stays between 1x and 2x; it takes calm markets and a strong forecast to see it rise. It can wipe out the account.

books_config.name: Gold
books_config.description: A quarter of Kelly on the gold fund, never levered and never short: the prudent book's rules, the forecast read on the price of gold itself. The market of geopolitics.

books_config.name: Copper
books_config.description: A quarter of Kelly on the copper fund, never levered and never short: the prudent book's rules, the forecast read on the price of copper itself. The market of electrification and data centres.

books_config.name: Agriculture
books_config.description: A quarter of Kelly on the agriculture fund (corn, soybeans, wheat, sugar, coffee, cocoa, livestock), never levered and never short: the prudent book's rules on the market the weather moves most.

options.method: A model, not a history of quotes: Black-Scholes on the OVX index, a fixed smile and a fixed bid-ask spread read on the USO chain of 8 October 2026, continuous strikes, 21 sessions to expiry, a wing 4% of the price wide.
